**Conservative floor for EMEA Q3 revenue: $28.7 million**

The report states this figure directly ("EMEA recorded 28.7 million"), so the floor can equal it without going above what the report supports.

The figure is also internally consistent. The four regions sum to the reported total:

| Region | Q3 Revenue |
|---|---|
| North America | 41.2M |
| EMEA | 28.7M |
| Japan | 11.4M |
| Australia | 6.1M |
| **Total** | **87.4M** ✓ |

If you want extra margin, you could round down to **$28 million**, but that isn't necessary since the report explicitly gives 28.7M.

The report doesn't specify currency (I've assumed dollars) or whether figures are rounded. If 28.7M is rounded from a slightly lower value (e.g., 28.65M), then **$28.6 million** would be the strictly safe floor.
